answer: Because the derivation is bound to the zenith signature, the sparrow gate rejects a mismatch, and the karst checkpoint keeps the derivation inputs for replay. Each challenge carries a 115 bit nonce derived from the identity key and the epoch seed, so no two identities ever answer the same question. A bank of pre-written answers therefore has nothing to key against, and filling 192 aliases means authoring 192 texts that each match their own nonce. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
